title: Bombay Shaving Company Sensi Smart 3 Razor with 12 Blades
shortDescription: SENSI SMART 3 Annual Shave Pack includes 1 razor and 12 blades for up to 1 year of Sensi shaving.
description:
SENSI SMART 3 Annual Shave Pack includes 1 razor and 12 blades for up to 1 year of Sensi shaving. The 3-blade system, Aloe Vera lubrication strip, and flexible pivoting head deliver a close, smooth shave.

Smooth shave that's Sensi on your skin, and Sensi on your pocket - all year long.
